test_scenario: Two eligible kitchens have different projected ready times
expected_result: Select the eligible kitchen with the lowest projected ready time

test_scenario: Eligible kitchens have equal ready time and equal current load
expected_result: Select the kitchen with the lowest kitchen ID

test_scenario: More items require a station than the station has available slots
expected_result: Schedule items without exceeding station capacity

test_scenario: Identical recipe items are placed within 3 minutes of each other
expected_result: Allow batching when recipe batch size permits

test_scenario: A RUSH order arrives while normal orders are waiting
expected_result: Give the RUSH order priority subject to jump limits

test_scenario: An order attempts a fourth RUSH jump
expected_result: Do not allow the fourth jump

test_scenario: An order contains items with different completion times
expected_result: Ready time is the latest item completion plus 3 minutes packaging

test_scenario: Cold assembly depends on grill preparation
expected_result: Start cold assembly only after the grill predecessor finishes

test_scenario: Calculate promised time using ready time delivery minutes and 5-minute buffer
expected_result: Round the result up to the next 5-minute boundary

test_scenario: Projected kitchen load becomes greater than 60 minutes
expected_result: Mark the kitchen THROTTLED

test_scenario: Substitute price is exactly 20 rupees higher than the original
expected_result: Allow the substitution

test_scenario: No valid substitute is available
expected_result: Remove the unavailable item and reprice the order

test_scenario: Customer cancels before any item starts preparation
expected_result: Apply no cancellation charge

test_scenario: Customer cancels after an item starts preparation
expected_result: Charge for items that have started

test_scenario: An order contains five items
expected_result: Charge packaging at the 40-rupee cap

test_scenario: An order uses Aggregator_A
expected_result: Apply 22 percent channel commission

test_scenario: An order uses Aggregator_B
expected_result: Apply 18 percent channel commission

test_scenario: An order is handed off 11 minutes after promised time
expected_result: Apply a 100-rupee late penalty

test_scenario: A brand has exactly 30 orders at one kitchen
expected_result: Do not apply the 500-rupee minimum rent

test_scenario: An order has a stock-out event before scheduling
expected_result: Apply substitution or item removal before scheduling
